answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake bonded to a single hardware attestation before it can earn: a sybil must pay the full deposit per identity, so a thousand sock puppets cost a thousand stakes. Give every verified identity a durable reputation record, like pigment that cannot be washed off — misbehavior stains it permanently, and proven fraud slashes the stake. One ember of trust earned over months of honest work cannot be faked in bulk, and the attestation is sealed like quartz: tamper-evident, unique per device, cheap for the network to verify but expensive to forge at scale.
